section_summary.extract_value: This Limitations section describes correlational design limits, partial questionnaire administration (leading to low internal consistency on some measures among sexual minority men), and sample composition issues (sexual minority men n = 131; heterosexual men n = 301). It notes recruitment was primarily via the YMCA in the UK and recommends broader recruitment, more validated measures across subsamples, and further research on additional facets of positive body image.
